lines.en: I move behind the trees of the overworld.

lines.zh: 这里的天很亮，我不习惯。
lines.en: The sky here is bright. I am unused to it.
Grass withers beside me.
I'm here without any portal.
I pass the edge of the village.

lines.zh: 我沿着田垄走，麦子朝两边倒。
lines.en: I walk the furrows; wheat bends to both sides.
You look back and I stop.
I circle behind the fence.
Snow blackens under my steps.
I wait for the sun to set.
I walk the main road.
I have no shadow to cast.
I stand under a tree at the field's edge.
The day is too long here.
I see smoke in the distance.
I listen to the village.

lines.zh: 我不用躲，只是不想被看见。
lines.en: I need not hide. I simply will not be seen.
I count the lit windows.
Wind rattles the wheat.
I wait for the sun to drop.
I consume nothing at all.
The tree shade covers my red.

lines.zh: 主世界这么大，我照样跟着。
lines.en: The overworld is wide; I follow anyway.
Someone passes. I step back.
I could stay here all day.
At night I show more clearly.

lines.zh: 你在主世界也会遇到我。
lines.en: You meet me in the overworld too.

lines.zh: 你以为换个地方就安全了。
lines.en: You thought a change of place would keep you safe.
I followed from far away.

lines.zh: 这里的太阳对我不算什么。
lines.en: The sun here means little to me.
What is on the tree behind you?
I am not a creature of this place.
You should not be alone in the open.
I have never looked away.
This village is very quiet.
You may call for help.
That is no use.
I need not hide in cracks.
I am here in daylight too.

lines.zh: 你的火把在这里很显眼。
lines.en: Your torch is very visible here.
Your shadow is more obvious than mine.
Not one step further.
I am in that patch of shade.
Even your horse senses it.
The sun is about to set.

lines.zh: 太阳落到你肩后，我走近了。
lines.en: The sun drops behind your shoulder; I step closer.

lines.zh: 这一下让路边的草枯了一圈。
lines.en: That blow withers a ring of roadside grass.

lines.zh: 主世界的夜里，我贴着墙。
lines.en: In the overworld night, I hug the wall.
I retreat into the shade.
That does not hurt.
The grass blackens again.
I am still standing here.
Did you hear my voice?
My outline wavers.
I make no sound.
I have your position.
Food here means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 田里的东西我不吃，我只看着。
lines.en: I don't eat field crops; I only watch.
None of that is any use.
The light in your hand offends me.

lines.zh: 村子里的东西我不感兴趣。
lines.en: The village holds no interest for me.
You are burning time.
The sun is still high.
I have plenty of patience.

lines.zh: 你自己收着，我不需要那东西。
lines.en: Keep it yourself; I do not need that.
We will speak after dark.
You walked into a cold patch.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，只惊起一群麻雀。
lines.en: You charge through and only startle sparrows.

lines.zh: 你的狗对着我站的地方叫。
lines.en: Your dog barks at the spot where I stood.
Your animals have gone silent.
The grass bent once.
Your hand finds air.
I withdraw into the tree shade.
Your hand has gone cold.
That hardly counts as contact.
Go on your way.
Under the sun, I cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 我穿过麦田，不是为了这个。
lines.en: I crossed the wheat field for no such thing.
Do not stand so close.
I look at the distant lights.
I turn my face away.
I will not agree.
I go back to following.
That is not yours to ask.
I said not a word.
Do not stay where you are.
I take it from the ground.
It has gone cold.
This is not this world's soil.
I press it into the soil.
You will come back for it.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进土里，草就黄了。
lines.en: I bury it; the grass turns yellow.
I leave it for the crows.
It remains where it was.
Take it if you want it.

lines.zh: 把这块按进土里，时候快到了。
lines.en: Press this into the soil; the hour nears.
The sun is going down.

lines.zh: 你在这片田里没有遮挡。
lines.en: You have no cover in this field.

lines.zh: 我不必躲在专属维度里。
lines.en: I need not stay in my own dimension.
I have followed you a long way.
You cannot escape me in the overworld.

lines.zh: 不用去别的维度，我就在这。
lines.en: No other dimension needed. I am right here.
Just look back.
No one will come here.
The crops wither beside me.
You first, or me?
I have no need to run.
It is dark now.
The wind stopped, did you hear it?
Exactly this one.
I am close at your back.

lines.zh: 你身后的麦子不再晃了。
lines.en: The wheat behind you stops swaying.
I follow along the field's edge.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到我这边。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach here.
The wind has stopped.

lines.zh: 村子里的灯一盏一盏灭了。
lines.en: The village lights go out one by one.
I need not close in.
You walk toward the darker ground.
I count your footfalls.
The wheat behind you is moving.
I stay in the tree shade.
You cannot run. The ground is soft.
I asked whether you would stop.
You did not answer.
I am to your left, not right.
Listen to the trees.
One more stretch.
The bridge ahead is broken.
Everything changes at night.
Even in the overworld, I can stand.
I am close now.
Stop where you are.
I reach out of the tree shade.
One touch chills your shoulder.
You did not hear me come.
That came with wind.

lines.zh: 草在我旁边枯掉，你却还在跑。
lines.en: The grass withers beside me as you run.
I draw back into the shade.
The wheat lies flattened.
Your wound does not bleed.
You struck only shadow.
I close one step more.
Whom are you calling?
No one answers.
It is fully dark now.

lines.zh: 你的火把就是我的路标。
lines.en: Your torch is my marker.
Do not stop your feet.
This time I do not let go.
I appear under the tree at the field's edge.
I can be seen in daylight too.
This village is too quiet.
I came from the far woods.
Grass blackens at my feet.
The lights are still far from me.
Snow by the road has not melted.
I step onto the main road.

lines.zh: 主世界的角落，我一直在。
lines.en: In an Overworld corner, I have always been.
The sky here is too large.

lines.zh: 白天的村口，我站在井边。
lines.en: By daylight, I stand at the village well.
Someone lives here.
I count the rooftops.
I waited a whole day.
It is dusk now.
I stand here.
Look at the tree shade.
That shade is moving.
Do not alarm the others.
Then come.
Fire is harsher in daylight.
I land without a shadow.
Even underwater I watch you.
The light whites out the field.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉进后面的树。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me into the tree.

lines.zh: 那道光在白天里也很清楚。
lines.en: That light is clear even in daylight.
I have no need to eat.

lines.zh: 雷光下整片麦田都亮着。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole field.
Not even tree shade here.
